label: tab:software
text: Main software packages and versions on the local machine (from requirements.txt). The Kaggle kernels used their pre-installed PyTorch and scikit-learn.

label: tab:devices
text: Device on which each architecture and the fine-tuning experiment were trained (results/v2/device_map.json).

label: tab:dataset_composition
text: Composition of the three distributed files and of the cleaned training collection (Benchmark_clean, Section 3.3). Source: results/data_audit.csv.

label: tab:provenance
text: Provenance of the three local files, established by comparison with the downloaded original files. Source: results/provenance.csv.

label: tab:conflicts
text: Duplicates and label conflicts in Benchmark_Dataset and their origin. Sources: results/data_audit.csv and results/v2/lineage_shared_training.csv.

label: tab:hashes
text: SHA-256 digests of the local data files and of the files in the AIPFusion-Net repository, downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenYH7693/AIPFusion-Net/main/AIPData/ on 2026-11-26. Source: results/v2/aipfusion_repo_check.csv.

label: tab:cleaning
text: Cleaning of Benchmark_Dataset, with the number of rows after each step. Source: results/data_audit.csv.

label: tab:identity
text: Identity screen of the independent sets against Benchmark_clean, and the shuffled-composition null control. Sources: results/identity_screen.csv and results/v2/null_control_identity.csv.

label: tab:esm
text: The ESM-2 checkpoints used as frozen feature extractors. Embedding times are single measurements for all unique sequences on the CPU of the machine used. Source: results/embedding_timings.csv and results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: tab:pooling
text: Pooling variants compared on frozen ESM-2 650M embeddings. Dimensions from results/v2/pooling_dimensions.csv.

label: tab:finetune
text: Fine-tuning protocol for the ESM-2 8M checkpoint and its frozen control. Source: results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: tab:training
text: Training settings of the multilayer perceptron and of the residue-level models. Source: results/v2/methods_parameters.csv.

label: tab:mde
text: Minimum detectable effect (80% power, two-sided α = 0.05) of the paired comparisons of λ > 0 with λ = 0 for each test set and regime. Source: results/v2/mde_summary.csv, derived from results/tables/T5.11_corrected_significance.csv.
